title: Acai Breakfast Bowl Recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 2 tbsp of orange juice, (optional, to thin the berry purée)
ldInstructionsRaw: Cut the banana in half lengthways and place half in a blender along with the frozen acai berry purée and honey. Blitz until smooth, adding a little orange juice to adjust the consistency as desired
Pour the acai mixture into a bowl and slice the remaining banana on top. Sprinkle with the granola and serve
